CHAPTER 8 · ITEM 08 / 13

Tax revenue and deadweight loss

Buyer spending and seller receipts買方支出與賣方淨收

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Assess whether buyer spending or seller revenue rises or falls after a tax using the demand and supply conditions; a lower seller price and lower quantity reduce seller receipts for ordinary positive prices.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

一般單位稅後賣方淨價及數量皆降，正價格下淨收入下降。買方價升而量跌，支出可升可跌，要看彈性或直接計算。

After a normal unit tax, Ps and Qt both fall, so seller net receipts fall for positive prices. Buyer spending can rise or fall because Pb rises while Q falls; use demand responsiveness or calculate the products.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Before tax P=10,Q=100, spending=1,000. After Pb=12,Q=90, spending=1,080 even though CS falls. 支出增加不代表福利增加。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Buyer price rises and quantity falls after tax. Buyer spending is always lower? 買方支出必下降嗎？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
